newly_created_holds.subject: extended stay america indianapolis airport -- ADDRESS CONFLICT
newly_created_holds.question: Is the census street stale, or does the brand slug reach a different building?
evidence: the census carries 5820 West Franklin Road, 46241, telephone 317-248-0465
the property page at extendedstayamerica.com/hotels/in/indianapolis/airport states 2730 Fortune Cir. W. with postal 46241
the census telephone IS present on that page, and the postal matches; only the street disagrees
a genuinely different building would not normally publish this row's telephone
newly_created_holds.recommendation: Hold. Do not correct in bulk. This needs one independent corroboration -- a brand single-property inventory listing for the Indianapolis airport ESA, or a second source naming 2730 Fortune Cir. W. -- before an address supersession is applied. The precedent for that discipline is the address review queue of order 006, which required exactly this before any of its six rows moved.
newly_created_holds.census_effect: one street supersession if confirmed; none otherwise
newly_created_holds.authority_effect: admits one PUBLISHED_PET_FRIENDLY row (the standard ESA policy) once settled
newly_created_holds.blocks_promotion: NO -- the row is held outside the clean inventory

newly_created_holds.subject: delta hotels by marriott indianapolis airport -- the committed route is DEAD
newly_created_holds.question: Is this property closed, renamed, or merely re-slugged?
evidence: this was the one Marriott URL in the cohort Firecrawl was allowed to reach, and the brand answered HTTP 404
every other Marriott row was refused before a status could be observed, so this is the only Marriott routing fact this market now has
a 404 from the brand is materially different from the 403 the free lane saw: a refusal proves nothing about whether the page exists, and this one says it does not
newly_created_holds.recommendation: Treat the route as dead and re-derive it from Marriott's own Indianapolis inventory before any further spend on this row. Under the standing rule a soft-404 or a hard 404 is a renamed slug until the brand inventory says otherwise, so closure must not be assumed.
newly_created_holds.census_effect: none until the inventory is read
newly_created_holds.routing_effect: one committed route is known bad and should not be re-attempted as-is
